fix.message: The painted look module is not used: start from scripts/new-lesson.mjs (a game: /skills/play/learning-game/scripts/new-game.mjs painted).
Own materials break the painting (and lit ones come out dark on the headset): paint every part with look.paint / look.mat(colour), lamps with look.lamp.
kit.material textures and shine fight the brush dabs: paint the part with look.paint(geometry, colour, name) (references/mistakes.md). Only lamps glow, with look.lamp.

note.message: No painted builders used: build the place with the look's builders (references/recipes.md).
No lamp or glow marks the active stop: light the stop the learner is at with a lamp (lamp.userData.set) or look.shine(stop) (references/teaching.md).
Nothing travels from stop to stop: move the traveller (cart, sack, boat, wind, a person) along a route (path.userData.route.at(u, v)) so the cause visibly carries on (references/teaching.md).
